title: Swap the content of two boxes
statement: Define a Box class with a public attribute content, and a Swap subprogram that takes two boxes and swaps their content (with no by-reference passing needed: the objects already share their identity). Read two values, create two boxes, swap their content and write the two resulting values, one per line.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with a class.

assertions.name: Swap
assertions.requirement: The statement asks for a subprogram named Swap with two parameters.
